title: RuriDragon
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Ruri Aoki wakes up with horns and learns from her mother that her never-mentioned father is a dragon, making her half-dragon. She keeps going to school while sneezing fire and sparking electricity, and the sudden attention pulls the somewhat unsocial girl into new friendships. The tone is mundane, dry slice-of-life comedy.
life_message: It holds up accepting yourself and others as you are, and letting ordinary kindness connect you.
